registry_name: Helix UK salary, labour-market and career enrichment source registry
principles: Prefer official UK sources and APIs.
Never expose API keys in the GitHub Pages frontend.
Do not perform arbitrary salary web searches from the end-user browser.
Cache and publish normalized data into the static application dataset.
Every published salary must carry provenance, geography, date, method and evidence quality.
A transparent indicative estimate is preferable to an invented or falsely precise salary.

NCS_API.name: National Careers Service Job Profiles API
NCS_API.license: Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated
NCS_API.auth: API subscription key required. Store only as a GitHub Actions secret named NCS_API_KEY.
use_for: career-specific starter and experienced salary ranges
SOC mapping where supplied by the API
NCS_API.notes: Preferred source when a career has an exact or strongly compatible NCS profile match. Salary figures are guidance estimates, not guaranteed pay.

ONS_API.name: Office for National Statistics API and ASHE
ONS_API.license: Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated
ONS_API.auth: No API key required for the ONS Beta API.
ONS_API.notes: Use the most detailed suitable SOC/ASHE data actually available. Clearly label broader occupational estimates.

NHS_ENGLAND_AFC.name: NHS Agenda for Change pay scales, England
use_for: verified public-sector salary context when a career has a curated NHS band mapping
medical and dental pay context using the separate official circulars
NHS_ENGLAND_AFC.notes: Never infer an NHS band solely from a career title. Use only curated or officially evidenced role-to-band mappings. Label geography as England.

NHS_SCOTLAND.name: NHS Scotland pay rates
NHS_SCOTLAND.notes: Keep separate from England, Wales and Northern Ireland pay contexts.

NHS_WALES.name: NHS Wales pay award and pay-scale sources
NHS_WALES.notes: The enrichment pipeline should locate and use the current official detailed Welsh pay-scale publication where available, not assume England's cash values.

HSC_NI.name: Health and Social Care Northern Ireland pay sources
HSC_NI.notes: Use current detailed official HSC pay circulars where available. Do not assume England cash values.

SKILLS_ENGLAND_OCCUPATIONAL_MAPS.name: Skills England Occupational Maps API
SKILLS_ENGLAND_OCCUPATIONAL_MAPS.auth: X-API-KEY required. Optional GitHub Actions secret: SKILLS_ENGLAND_API_KEY.
SKILLS_ENGLAND_OCCUPATIONAL_MAPS.notes: Optional enhancement. It is not a primary salary source.
